project.title: Skin bacterial DNA leaves a trace in everywhere: Bacterial fingerprint is analyzed by NGS.
project.description: This study include microbial forensic sampling, DNA preparation, metagenomic processing, next genaration sequencing and clustering analysis protocols.Human skin microbiome based on the 16S rRNA encoding gene can show species diversity within and between individuals. The variation in microbial species composition and gene pools within the human touched trace evidence will be studied.
